title: Sales channels
intro: Each channel has its prices. The main channel carries the products' selling price; another channel without its own price follows it. A market channel only has orders placed during an event. Linked to a service, a channel prices the imported sales and the exported catalogue.
removeMessage: Its prices are forgotten: products keep their selling price. Past orders do not change.
name: Name
serviceHint: Sales imported from this service are counted at its prices.

kindHints.market: Its orders always have an event.
kindHints.direct: Sales neither at an event nor online (gifts, sales to friends…).

mainHint: Main channel: its prices are the products' selling prices.

prices.title: Prices
prices.intro: Without its own price, a product follows its {main} price.
prices.mainIntro: This channel's prices are the products' selling prices.
prices.batchIntro: Changes the price on this channel of the shown product. | Changes the price on this channel of the {count} shown products.
prices.apply: Apply to {count} product | Apply to {count} products

supplies.title: Supplies
supplies.intro: The supplies that can be added to this channel's orders (sleeves, envelopes…). They are taken from stock.
supplies.none: No supply: create some in Products › Supplies.

costs.title: Costs per order
costs.intro: Taxes, fees and fixed costs paid on each order of this channel. They are computed when the order is created; postage is typed on each order.
costs.removeMessage: Past orders keep their costs, unless you recompute them.
costs.label: Name
